sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submit that this interlocutory application has been filed with the prayer for early hearing of the instant Cr.M.P. Since, the hearing of instant Cr.M.P. is taken up today, hence, this interlocutory application stands disposed of being infructuous.

This Cr.M.P. has been filed invoking the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 528 of the BNSS, 2023 with the prayer to quash the orders dated 25.11.2021 & 18.06.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Dhanbad in Special (POCSO) Case No.12 of 2019 whereby and whereunder respectively, non-bailable warrant of arrest has been issued against the petitioner and charge has been framed under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act against the absconding accused person in his absence; without complying the requirement of section 356(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita for exercising the power under Section 356(1) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.

Considering the facts of the case, the Registrar General of the Court is directed to call for a report from the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Dhanbad by supplying him a copy of the order dated 18.06.2024 kept at page no.22 of this brief in connection with Spl.(P)-12/2019 which has apparently wrongly been mentioned as Spl.(P)-12/20219 as to under what circumstances and in the absence of Rahul Kumar Prasad Verma @ Rahul Verma vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
